published_title: The Son of the Happy Fun Ball of Death
description: After seeing two TTO decks at a Classic tournament, I felt like whipping this deck up quickly for some fun games.
strategy:
Until it gets a helper, building the DSII is pretty much a fun deck. I start off with Endor Ops because about 85% of decks are using Strike Planning, and getting force choked is not fun.

Strategy:

First action, use Mob combo to pull Gall from your reserve. If you feel you need to, pull Endor shield as well. Deploy the DSII. If they suspend Mob Points, unsuspend it ASAP with a fighter and pilot, so you can dump it for Desperate Counter, which you will use to pull IAO combo and Combat Response. If you have enough, deploy Jerjerrod to either the Bunker or the DSII:DB and begin setting up the DSII.

When the DSII is operational, move it to Gall. Have your ground forces take the Spaceport DB to add to TTO. If you are confident enough in your space forces, you can try to hold Endor as well. Pretty simple, and hopefully you will do enough damage agains the opponent.

Card Choices

Endor Shield: Against decks that set up space quickly, use this to help prevent them from setting up a drain of 5. Especially against MBO decks, this can be quite helpful.

Tallon Roll Combo: I've critiscized others about using this with the DSII, but I've realized this can be a nice surprise at other systems.

Again, this is more for my amusement than winning tournaments. Any suggestions would be wonderful.
